guide.description: fg brings a background job back to the foreground and waits for it to finish. Give it %<id> to pick a specific job, or nothing at all to grab the most recently backgrounded one.

flags.desc: which job to bring back — omit it to target the most recent one

examples.note: brings job 1 to the foreground and waits

exercises.title: Bring a job to the foreground
exercises.task: Start a job with 'sleep 5 &', then bring it back with 'fg %1'.

exercises.title: fg without a job number
exercises.task: Start 'sleep 4 &', then bring it to the foreground WITHOUT specifying a job number — plain 'fg' targets the most recent job.
